subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker for WebChat project/topic conversation management plus multi-AI collaboration, and which narrower milestone should be specified first?
rationale: The remaining request adds durable product objects, protocol/storage shape, UI hierarchy, and orchestration semantics that cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella, split milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open and define narrower milestones for project/session metadata, WebChat directory navigation, and later multi-model collaboration semantics.

options.title: Narrow to conversation directory
options.body: Retain the session/project organization work here and move committee/multi-AI workflows to a separate design tracker.

options.title: Defer broad orchestration
options.body: Leave current flat sessions and sub-agent primitives as the supported path until maintainers sponsor a larger project/workspace model.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, split milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define narrower milestones for project/session metadata, WebChat directory navigation, and later multi-model collaboration semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the canonical-tracker signal and authored the current session-thread slice, making them the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
